title: VMs can't boot with Network Mode set to Bridged on Apple M5 Pro machines
excerpt: Describe the issue Can't boot VMs with Network Mode set to 'Bridged' on machines with the new Apple M5 Pro I tested the latest ubuntu-24.04.4-live-server-arm64.iso It boots fine with Network Mode s...
content_html:
Describe the issue
Can't boot VMs with Network Mode set to 'Bridged' on machines with the new Apple M5 Pro
I tested the latest ubuntu-24.04.4-live-server-arm64.iso
It boots fine with Network Mode set to 'Host Only' or 'Extended'

Configuration

  • UTM Version: 4.7.5 (118)
  • macOS Version: 26.3.1 (a)
  • Mac Chip (Intel, M1, ...): M5 Pro

Crash log
The app doesn't crash, it just sits on the loading screen immediately after pressing run

Debug log
Unfortunately it doesn't get to a point where the option to export the debug log is shown

Upload VM
config.plist.zip
